sources.title: Acme Corp announces APAC expansion with Singapore hub
sources.snippet: Acme Corp announced plans to establish a regional headquarters in Singapore as part of a broader push into Asia-Pacific markets, targeting a 2027 launch.

sources.title: Acme Corp to Open Singapore Regional HQ — Official Press Release
sources.snippet: Acme Corp (NASDAQ: ACME) today announced the establishment of its Asia-Pacific regional headquarters in Singapore, effective Q1 2027.

sources.title: Acme Corp Q3 results: revenue up 14% as margins compress
sources.snippet: Acme Corp reported Q3 revenue growth of 14% year-over-year, falling short of analyst expectations of 18%, while operating margins declined from 22% to 19%.

sources.title: Acme Corp CFO departs amid strategic review
sources.snippet: Acme Corp's Chief Financial Officer resigned last week, the company confirmed, citing personal reasons. An interim CFO has been appointed while a search is underway.
